name: protocol_golden_m7
description: The GDScript codec decodes every message of the M7 golden transcript (a duel found through the queue, recorded from the Python server: two duellists alone, Match Found for two seats, both accepts, MATCH_CONFIG one a side, a RESULT with one outcome for each side, MATCH_END won and lost, and Play again queueing again) into the listed values, and encodes each back to the same bytes.

steps.msg: all 55 records decode and re-encode byte for byte
the transcript speaks this game's protocol version
Match Found for two, both accepts, and the queue entered twice and again
the duel's config, its results and its ends are in
